units_checked.description: ids of every reference entry in your batch that you actually compared

unit.description: the entry id, exactly as in the batch

text.description: what the entry says, what the Crossref record says, and which field

doi.description: the DOI whose record you compared (required when the entry has several)

old_text.description: year or title-typo: the text to replace, copied exactly from the entry

crossref_field.description: the record field that supports the fix: issued, published-print, published-online or title

crossref_value.description: that field value, copied exactly from the record
